newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Vitarich 9-mth net loss 571.225 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Vitarich 9-mth net loss 571.225 mln pesos.

text.p: Animal feed producer and poultry breeder Vitarich Corp said on Monday its net loss in the first three quarters of 1996 was 571.225 million pesos, caused by a glut in the poultry industry.
The company said net sales in the nine months from January to September reached 4.693 billion pesos.
It did not give comparative figures for the nine-month period last year but it said it made net profits of 280.256 million pesos for the entire 1995 on net sales of 5.681 billion pesos.
For the third quarter alone, it posted a smaller net loss of 75.450 million pesos compared to losses of 290.481 million and 205.293 million pesos in the first and second quarters respectively.
The company said it will cut down its workforce to reduce operating expenses and dispose non-essential assets to improve its liquidity.
